From the Founder

Hi, I'm Benson 👋

I built Sweetee to help me and my girlfriend Ya connect more meaningfully in a long distance relationship. I've found that it's easy to get stuck exchanging updates instead of actually sharing things together.

I want to create a space for play and real conversation, a break from the daily routine. After all, it's these small moments that compound into a stronger bond over time.

I hope you and your person find something special in here too. :)

Benson, founder of Sweetee
